scope: Fresh/upgrade installation followed by QEMU IDE HIGH/LOW text and national filename workflows in all Baltic languages. Physical COMMAND/EDLIN input, exact saved/reopened CP775 text, redirection, FIND and actual rendered glyphs use installed utilities. National filename batch commands exercise country case/order/wildcards, MOVE/XCOPY trees and fresh-boot reads/cleanup on FAT16. Installed payloads, the default root shell, baseline images and CONFIG recipes remain intact. This gate does not qualify installed 286 workflows or full source-matched release/reproducibility.
